Maintainer.Profile:
heroeswearkapes maintains ComfyUI Intel XPU, a Docker image designed to make running ComfyUI with native PyTorch XPU acceleration on Intel Arc GPUs straightforward, with a focus on Docker and Unraid deployments.
The project includes Intel Level Zero and OpenCL runtime support, ComfyUI Manager, Hugging Face CLI, aria2, persistent model storage, and automatic ComfyUI model directory creation.
Initial development and validation was performed using an Intel Arc Pro B70 32 GB GPU with the Linux xe driver.
